title: NICE AND EASY
purpose: A first taste of the track. Short and quick, then longer and smooth.

title: SPEED DEMONS
purpose: Short and fast. The speed that makes every other pace feel easier.

title: PYRAMID INTERVALS
purpose: Up and back down. The same effort at every length.

title: FIVE BY ONE
purpose: Five even kilometres. The session that teaches pace.

title: 5K PYRAMID
purpose: A 5K, broken up. Rise into it, then come down quick and light.

title: BROKEN 5K
purpose: 5K of work in 800s and 400s, with room to breathe between.

title: DESCENDING LADDER
purpose: Every rep shorter than the last. Hold your form as it gets quicker.

title: LONG HOLDS 01
purpose: Two 10-minute holds. Build the effort you can sustain.

title: LONG HOLDS 02
purpose: Three 8-minute holds. The same effort, three times.

title: CONTINUOUS 22
purpose: 22 minutes, unbroken. The steady gear for 10K and longer.
